Build a Vite React app with Tailwind CSS and a black/purple-blue gradient dark theme. Create a single mobile-first Player screen with a real HTML5 <audio> element. Load a small hardcoded playlist of 2-3 real public-domain MP3s served from the cloud (e.g., SoundHelix URLs) so audio is truly streamed, not local. Implement working controls: Play/Pause, Next, Previous, a seek range input tied to currentTime/duration, current/duration labels, a volume range input, Shuffle and Repeat toggles that actually affect queue behavior, album artwork from a public image URL, song title and artist labels, and a visible buffering/loading indicator. Make every control functional; do not add any button that only logs to console or simulates behavior. Provide an .env.example file for future backend credentials but no fake values. Keep the code ready for React Router and Capacitor. Restate the user constraints: this must become a fully functional online music application, not just a UI demo; audio must stream from cloud storage; only authorized Admin can upload/edit/delete songs; normal users must not access Admin functions; all uploaded songs must remain available online until the Admin removes them; Admin uploads songs only once; and the administrator is responsible for uploading only music they have rights to distribute.
